name: CLP Catholic Mass
description: The Roman Catholic Mass Celebration is a religious liturgy whose origins date back to the first century. The mass is celebrated in each country of the world every day amongst people of various cultures, backgrounds, languages, and traditions. Given this ancient liturgy’s ties to culture and history, it is a great learning opportunity for students to witness as it has been a pivotal ceremony for the world as a whole. The mass is divided into two sections: Liturgy of the Word and Liturgy of the Eucharist. Students attending the mass will hear various pieces of literature from the BC Jewish Era, writings from the Gospels detailing Jesus’s life, and readings from the early church fathers. After the conclusion of the mass, students will have the opportunity to ask questions.

name: CCM Gathering "Religion vs. Science"
description: This Wednesday night we will be discussing the relationship between religion and science. Is this relationship a battle or a friendship? Come out at 7:30pm for dinner.
